title: Performance and capability impressions
summary: The topic centers on favorable comments about how the G60 performs, with many other fragments describing comparative performance or capability without a clearly classifiable sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car’s overall performance and pairing of design with how it drives.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention better performance, quicker responses, engine performance, or improved hands-off capability, but the brief wording does not provide enough context for a clear sentiment label.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the available evidence for clearly expressed sentiment is limited.
Several examples are very short comparative statements, which makes the specific performance aspect and sentiment difficult to interpret with confidence.
The topic includes loosely related performance references across powertrain, handling, and driver-assistance capability rather than one tightly defined feature area.
